$comment: Machine-readable contract source for the AutoFlow gate hook (issue #223). Single source of truth read by tests/test-issue-223-schema-hook-contract.sh to assert the hook's in-script literals/keys/paths equal these declared values. Values mirror .claude/hooks/check-autoflow-gate.sh EXACTLY; do not edit one without the other or the contract test fails (that is the drift signal).
$comment_closed_world: Issue #245 cycle-2 closed-world vocabulary. The hook validator (AUTOFLOW-SCHEMA-VALIDATION) accepts ONLY these top-level keys (or a fix_regression_cycle_N matching cycle_key_grammar), verdicts in verdict_enum (or empty/absent — gate-not-triggered, CLAUDE.md verdict rule), and scores in score_range; every other shape → MALFORMED → fail-closed. Mirror the hook EXACTLY (drift = contract-test failure).
$comment_score_shapes: Accepted shapes of a single phases.<gate>.scores entry (issue #55). Validated by execution, not by a grep against a hook literal: is_score names neither shape, so each member here is injected into a real state file and driven through the real hook, and the CLAUDE.md SCORE-SHAPE-EXAMPLE fence is compared to this array by shape-set equality.
$comment_remedy_class: Issue #275: an optional phases.<gate>.remedy_class is closed to this enum as a non-empty string (an open re-entry — a GATE:QUALITY FAIL's routed class, or a recommendation attempt not yet re-scored clean); any other value — an explicit null included; only the field's absence is 'no open re-entry' — → MALFORMED → fail-closed, so the push / pr-create open-re-entry deny cannot fail open on a malformed value.
$comment_remedy_class_phase_keys: The known phase keys whose optional remedy_class the validator closes to remedy_class_enum — every phase recommendation triage can leave an open attempt on, the un-score-gated structure form included. Distinct from gated_phase_keys, which decides which phases the score gates read.
